reviewScope: preview-product-boundary-successor.v1 only. This review does not mark DR-117 SATISFIED, open D-056 Class A, apply or seal the candidate, invent the DR-131 pack, authorize docs/v2/implementation/, or edit file 02, file 08, COORD, or any subject.
summary: REJECT at 1 blocker and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Custody, both source pins, the seven-entry count, candidate-only status, marketplace/WASM/imperative/network refusals, v8/preview-v2 non-SATISFIED standing, DR-131 non-invention, and the item-7 install/role/independent-release decisions all survive. The live DR-117 cell is not answered, however: file 02's fourth item includes required enforcement evidence, while the subject truncates that item name and replaces the evidence contract with a generic statement that confinement/marketplace evidence remains condition 4 / post-preview. It names no enforcement invariants, retained negative classes, exact DR-G owners, or coverage for lifecycle/discovery, contribution authority, imperative hooks/commands, network/egress, and the partial substrate replacement. That is missing design, not a named execution-only remainder. Separately, item 5 says absolutely that probes remain excluded, contradicting D-002's adopted host-owned consented doctor probes and the already owner-recorded preview distinction between host acts and contribution-granted probes. DR-117 remains OPEN; this verdict authorizes nothing.

blockers.title: The required enforcement-evidence half of the live DR-117 cell is deferred without a design contract
blockers.measurement: The live acceptance-evidence cell is quoted correctly as 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence.' File 02 item 4 is 'untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence'. The subject shortens the item name to 'untrusted native or WASM admission' and says only 'NO. DR-128 stays post-MVP. Fault containment (DR-G21) is not a sandbox.' Its sole operative treatment of evidence is previewReadAs: 'Enforcement evidence for confinement/marketplace remains condition 4 / post-preview.' No object defines what must be enforced, what retained negative evidence proves each exclusion, which exact condition-4/DR-G harness owns each remainder, or how the other boundary surfaces are covered. The generic phrase mentions only confinement/marketplace, not lifecycle/discovery, contribution-role authority, imperative probes/hooks/root commands, network/egress, or the partially replaced install/substrate shape.
blockers.governingConflict: D-056's pinned eligibility rule allows only harness execution, fixture execution, or qualification measurement to remain after the design contract; fixture/harness specifications, schemas, successors, missing design, and undecided rules are not splittable remainders. It also requires every execution remainder to be named as a condition-4 / DR-G obligation with an owner. The subject supplies neither the enforcement specification nor the per-remainder mapping. DR-G21's explicit non-sandbox disclaimer is accurate, but it makes the gap sharper: DR-G21 cannot be the missing confinement evidence, and DR-128's post-MVP deferral does not prove preview non-admission or the other exclusions.
counterexamples: A host exposes no marketplace UI but still admits an authenticated manifest from an unapproved external publisher. The seven NO/PARTIAL sentences contain no retained admission-refusal class that would fail this implementation.

A first-party component manifest claims a project hook, root command, policy object, or host-lifecycle callback. The subject says the product item is NO but names no closed manifest/admission invariant or negative evidence proving those claims are rejected.

Analyze is nominally offline but a component or host broker receives an undeclared egress path. 'No network-granted analysis default' supplies no enforcement oracle, gate mapping, or retained denial evidence.

The default useful install couples the selected TypeScript closure to the core release despite the prose assertion that independent release is preserved. No release-selection or no-lockstep evidence class in this subject distinguishes preservation from silent narrowing.
blockers.whyBlocker: The artifact's purpose is to disposition the seven product-boundary items as the preview successor, and the live cell makes enforcement evidence part of that successor rather than optional qualification prose. This is not a request to execute a harness now: it is the missing design-level specification that would make later execution mechanical and attributable. Accepting the candidate would certify the central cell while one of its two explicit limbs and a material part of file 02 item 4 remain undesigned.
blockers.requiredRepair: In a successor, restore the full item-4 identity including 'and required enforcement evidence'. Add an enforcement-evidence section that maps every NO/PARTIAL disposition to a closed invariant, retained positive/negative evidence class, exact existing DR-G/harness owner where one exists, and explicit later-execution standing. At minimum cover: refusal of marketplace/public-catalog and external-discovery admission; first-party/explicit-trust admission; rejection of untrusted native/WASM; rejection of contributor-owned policy/persistence/rendering/termination/lifecycle, project hooks, root commands, and probes; offline analyze plus egress denial; the default-useful-install inventory, core-only management boundary, TypeScript-only preview role, Rust-sidecar deferral, and independently releasable/selectable closure. If an existing gate does not own a required class, name that as remaining design work rather than calling it condition 4. Keep every harness unexecuted/not QUALIFIED and do not mark DR-117 SATISFIED.

shouldFix.title: The item-5 probe refusal erases the adopted host-act versus contribution-role distinction
shouldFix.subjectClaim: NO. Probe and untrusted imperative remain excluded.
shouldFix.refutation: D-002's adopted preview commands include doctor with a read-only/no-network default and consented probes, and its DR-105 scoping expressly includes local read/write plus consented doctor probes. The already owner-recorded preview disposition product-boundary-preview.v2 states the necessary distinction exactly: item 5 is excluded as contribution roles; host-owned doctor consented probes remain host acts, not contribution-granted probes; no contributor may own a root command. The new sentence drops every qualifier and says probes remain excluded absolutely.
shouldFix.impact: Read together with the item name, the intended P-2 contributor-role refusal is recoverable, so this is not a second blocker. But a literal consumer can remove or reject the adopted doctor feature, or conflate a host-authorized probe with an imperative component contribution. That narrows D-002 despite the user-authorized 'Keep D-002 as adopted' boundary and makes item 5 disagree with the live preview scope.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: State that imperative contributions, contribution-owned probes/project hooks/root commands, and other beyond-P-2 roles are excluded. Preserve host-owned consented doctor probes as host acts under D-002/D-032 and state that no contributor owns a root command. Keep analyze offline and keep component/network grants excluded.
